```{r load}
library(pacman)
p_load(here,broom,ggspatial,ggpubr,ggnewscale)
source(here("source","utils.R"))
reload_source()
cbbPalette <- c("#000000", "#E69F00", "#56B4E9", "#009E73", "#F0E442", "#0072B2", "#D55E00", "#CC79A7")

## load in original data with random forest predictions
analysis_data <- readRDS("generated_data/dat_with_raster_covs.rds") %>% 
    mutate(div_name=gsub(" Division","",Division_name)) %>% 
    group_by(hhid) %>% 
    mutate(hh_inf_other=sum(pred_365, na.rm=T)-pred_365>0)

## load 365-day results 
results_365 <- readRDS("generated_data/results-rf-365-youden.rds")

## make sure that seroincidence estimates are correct
results_365$seroincidence_dat <- results_365$loc_adjusted_incidence %>% 
    group_by(rep_ind) %>%
    summarize(adjusted_reps=mean(adjusted_reps),
              poststrat_reps=mean(poststrat_reps))

## load INLA nationwide seroincidence results
inla_est <- readRDS("generated_data/INLA-seroincidence-est.rds")
grid_est <- readRDS("generated_data/grid-cell-data.rds")

## read in map data
bgd0 <- load_bgd_shp(0) %>% transform_to_btm()
bgd2 <- load_bgd_shp(2) %>% transform_to_btm()

bgd1 <- load_bgd_shp(1) %>%
    mutate(adm1name=NAME_1) %>% 
    mutate(NAME_1=ordered(NAME_1,
                          levels=c("Rangpur", "Rajshahi",
                                   "Dhaka", "Sylhet",
                                   "Khulna", "Barisal",
                                   "Chittagong")))

## load in INLA grid cell estimates
map_dat <- readRDS("generated_data/grid-cell-data.rds")

sampling_locs <- analysis_data %>% 
    filter(!is.na(CommLat)) %>%
    select(CommLong,CommLat) %>% 
    st_as_sf(coords=c("CommLong","CommLat"),
             crs="+proj=longlat +datum=WGS84 +no_defs") %>% 
    distinct() %>% 
    mutate(var=1)

bgd2_dat <- readRDS("generated_data/bgd2-seroincidence.rds")
```

## Abstract


```{r abstract}
print("Nationwide median seroincidence rate estimate, with 95% CI (from INLA)")
formatC(100*quantile(inla_est$est_rate, probs=c(0.5, .025, .975)),1,format="f")

print("Minimum community incidence")
formatC(100*min(results_365$loc_adjusted_incidence$poststrat_incidence),1,format="f")

print("Maximum community incidence")
formatC(100*max(results_365$loc_adjusted_incidence$poststrat_incidence),1,format="f")

print("Median estimate of total infections, with 95% CI (from INLA), millions")
formatC(quantile(inla_est$est_total/1e6, probs=c(0.5, .025, .975)),1,format="f")
```


## Results: overall estimates

```{r overall}
print("Proportion of sample with vibriocidal titers greater than or equal to 320")
formatC(100*mean(analysis_data$vib_320, na.rm=T),1,format="f")

print("In-sample posterior median seroincidence rate, with 95% CI (from Stan)")
formatC(100*quantile(results_365$seroincidence_dat$poststrat_reps, probs=c(0.5, .025, .975)),1,format="f")

print("Nationwide median seroincidence rate estimate, with 95% CI (from INLA)")
formatC(100*quantile(inla_est$est_rate, probs=c(0.5, .025, .975)),1,format="f")
```

## Results: household and community

```{r hh}
print("Minimum and maximum proportion of household members infected")
hh_dat <- analysis_data %>% 
    group_by(hhid) %>% 
    summarize(obs=n(),
              n_pos=sum(pred_365, na.rm=T),
              sero_pct=n_pos/obs)
formatC(100*quantile(hh_dat$sero_pct, probs=c(0,1)),1,format="f")

print("Proportion and total number of households with no members infected")
formatC(100*mean(hh_dat$sero_pct==0),1,format="f")
sum(hh_dat$sero_pct==0)

print("Increase in risk due having at least one other seropositive household member.")
print("Mean and 95% CI from GLM")
hh_inf_glm <- glm(pred_365~hh_inf_other, data=analysis_data,
                  family=binomial(link="log"))
# summary(hh_inf_glm)
print("Mean increase:")
formatC(exp(hh_inf_glm$coefficients[2]), 2, format="f")
formatC(exp(confint(hh_inf_glm)[2,]), 2, format="f")

print("Number of communities with incidence under 5% (from Stan post-stratified in-sample)")
results_365$loc_adjusted_incidence %>% 
    filter(rep_ind==1, poststrat_incidence < .05) %>% 
    summarize(num=n(),
              pct=100*num/70)

print("Number of communities with incidence over 50% (from Stan post-stratified in-sample)")
results_365$loc_adjusted_incidence %>% 
    filter(rep_ind==1, poststrat_incidence > .5) %>% 
    summarize(num=n(),
              pct=100*num/70)

## find ICC
"ICC (household)"
sig_h <- results_365$sigma_h
sig_c <- results_365$sigma_comm
icc_h <- (sig_h^2)/(sig_h^2 + sig_c^2 + pi^2/3)
icc_c <- (sig_c^2)/(sig_h^2 + sig_c^2 + pi^2/3)
paste0(formatC(100*median(icc_h),1, format="f"), " (95% CI ",
       formatC(100*quantile(icc_h, probs=.025),1, format="f"), "-",
       formatC(100*quantile(icc_h, probs=.975),1, format="f"), "%)")
"ICC (community)"
paste0(formatC(100*median(icc_c),1, format="f"), " (95% CI ",
       formatC(100*quantile(icc_c, probs=.025),1, format="f"), "-",
       formatC(100*quantile(icc_c, probs=.975),1, format="f"), "%)")
"ICC (household) + ICC (community)"
paste0(formatC(100*median(icc_c+icc_h),1, format="f"), " (95% CI ",
       formatC(100*quantile(icc_c+icc_h, probs=.025), format="f",1), "-",
       formatC(100*quantile(icc_c+icc_h, probs=.975), format="f",1), "%)")
```

## Results: INLA univariate models

```{r inla-univariate}
cov_ests <- read_csv("generated_data/covariate_ests.csv")

"Under-10 relative risk vs. over-20 (aOR)"
formatC(1/cov_ests$median[cov_ests$variable=="0-9 years" & cov_ests$model=="univariate"],1, format="f")
paste0("(aOR ",
       formatC(cov_ests$median[cov_ests$variable=="0-9 years" &
                                 cov_ests$model=="univariate"],2, format="f"), ", 95% CI ",
       formatC(cov_ests$low[cov_ests$variable=="0-9 years" &
                                 cov_ests$model=="univariate"],2, format="f"), "-",
       formatC(cov_ests$high[cov_ests$variable=="0-9 years" &
                                 cov_ests$model=="univariate"],2, format="f"), ")")

"Males vs. Females"
paste0("aOR ",
       formatC(cov_ests$median[cov_ests$variable=="male" &
                                 cov_ests$model=="univariate"],2, format="f"), " (95% CI ",
       formatC(cov_ests$low[cov_ests$variable=="male" &
                                 cov_ests$model=="univariate"],2, format="f"), "-",
       formatC(cov_ests$high[cov_ests$variable=="male" &
                                 cov_ests$model=="univariate"],2, format="f"), ")")

"Urban"
paste0("aOR ",
       formatC(cov_ests$median[cov_ests$variable=="urban" &
                                 cov_ests$model=="univariate"],2, format="f"), " (95% CI ",
       formatC(cov_ests$low[cov_ests$variable=="urban" &
                                 cov_ests$model=="univariate"],2, format="f"), "-",
       formatC(cov_ests$high[cov_ests$variable=="urban" &
                                 cov_ests$model=="univariate"],2, format="f"), ")")

```

## Results: INLA LOOCV and relative risk

```{r loocv}
loocv_dat <- readRDS("generated_data/loocv-results.rds")
null_mae <- mean(abs(loocv_dat$null_mean-loocv_dat$truth))
full_mae <- mean(abs(loocv_dat$full_mean-loocv_dat$truth))
naive_mae <- mean(abs(loocv_dat$naive_mean-loocv_dat$truth))

print("LOOCV null bias")
paste0(formatC(100*(mean(loocv_dat$null_mean) - mean(loocv_dat$truth)),1, format="f"),"%")

print("LOOCV null MAE")
paste0(formatC(100*null_mae,1, format="f"),"%")

print("LOOCV null rMAE")
paste0(formatC(100*(1-null_mae/naive_mae),1, format="f"),"%")

print("LOOCV naive MAE")
paste0(formatC(100*naive_mae,1, format="f"),"%")

print("LOOCV alt bias")
paste0(formatC(100*(mean(loocv_dat$full_mean) - mean(loocv_dat$truth)),1, format="f"),"%")

print("LOOCV alt MAE")
paste0(formatC(100*full_mae,1, format="f"),"%")
```

```{r fig1, cache=T}
## find the adjusted incidence by location
loc_inc_plot <- results_365$loc_adjusted_incidence %>%
    group_by(community_id, obs) %>%
    summarise(inc_median=median(poststrat_incidence),
              inc_mean=mean(poststrat_reps),
              inc_lb=quantile(poststrat_reps, probs=.025),
              inc_ub=quantile(poststrat_reps, probs=.975)) %>% 
    ungroup() %>% 
    left_join(analysis_data %>%
                  select(community_id, Division_name) %>%
                  distinct()) %>% 
    mutate(div_name=gsub(" Division","",Division_name),
           div_name=ordered(div_name,
                            levels=c("Rangpur", "Rajshahi",
                                     "Dhaka", "Sylhet",
                                     "Khulna", "Barisal",
                                     "Chittagong"))) %>% 
    group_by(div_name) %>% 
    arrange(inc_median, inc_ub, inc_lb) %>% 
    mutate(div_rank=row_number(inc_median))

dat_community_sum <- analysis_data %>%
    group_by(community_id) %>%
    summarize(easting=CommLong[1],
              northing=CommLat[1]) %>%
    left_join(loc_inc_plot) %>%
    left_join(analysis_data)

loc_plot <- ggplot(loc_inc_plot, aes(y=div_rank)) +
    geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin=inc_lb, xmax=inc_ub),
                   color="gray50", height=0.2) +
    geom_point(aes(x=inc_median, color=div_name), size=2) +
    facet_grid(div_name~., scales="free_y", space="free_y", switch="y") +
    scale_y_discrete("") +
    scale_x_continuous("Seroincidence",
                       breaks=seq(0,1,.25),
                       limits=c(0,1)) +
    scale_color_manual("",
                       values=cbbPalette[-1],
                       guide="none") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.text.x=element_text(color="black"),
          axis.text.y=element_blank(),
          axis.ticks.y=element_blank(),
          strip.text.y.left=element_text(angle=0),
          strip.background.y=element_blank())

inc_map <- ggplot() +
    geom_sf(data=bgd1,
            aes(fill=as.factor(NAME_1), color=as.factor(NAME_1)),
            alpha=0.5) +
    scale_fill_manual(values=cbbPalette[-1],
                      guide="none") +
    scale_color_manual(values=cbbPalette[-1],
                       guide="none") +
    new_scale("color") +
    geom_point(data=dat_community_sum,
               aes(x=easting,y=northing,color=inc_median),
               pch=17,size=2, inherit.aes=F) +
    scale_color_gradient("Seroincidence",
                         low="white",high="black",
                         breaks=seq(0,1,.25),
                         limits=c(0,1)) +
    theme_void() +
    coord_sf(datum = NA) +
    theme(legend.position=c(.7,.85),
          legend.direction="horizontal",
          legend.key.width=unit(0.75, "cm")) +
    guides(color=guide_colorbar(title.position="top",title.hjust=0.5))

ggarrange(inc_map,loc_plot, ncol=2, labels = c("A", "B"))

ggsave(here("figures","fig1_raw.pdf"),height=6,width=10)
ggsave(here("figures","fig1_raw.png"),height=6,width=10)
```

```{r fig2, cache=T}
covs_rr_cor_plot <-
    ggplot() +
    geom_sf(data = map_dat,
            aes(fill = rr_med_bound), color=NA,lwd = 0) +
    geom_sf(data = bgd0, fill = NA, lwd = 0.5) +
    geom_sf(data = sampling_locs, aes(shape=as.factor(var)),
            size = 1.2,
            show.legend="point") +
    scale_fill_distiller("Relative\nInfection\nRisk",
                         palette="Spectral",
                         limits=c(-1, 1),
                         breaks=-1:1,
                         labels=c(" 0.5", " 1", " 2")) + 
    scale_shape_manual("", labels="Sampled\nCommunity", values=6,
                       guide=guide_legend(override.aes=list(color="black",
                                                            alpha=1))) +
    coord_sf(datum = NA)  +
    ggspatial::annotation_scale(location = "bl", style = "bar",
                                bar_cols = c(alpha("black",.6), "white"),
                                line_width = .3) + 
    labs(x = "") +
    labs(y = "") +
    theme_void() +
    theme(legend.spacing.y=unit(0.5, "cm"))

covs_infections_plot <-
    ggplot() +
    geom_sf(data = map_dat,
            aes(fill = ceiling(implied_inf)), color=NA,lwd = 0) +
    geom_sf(data = bgd0, fill = NA, lwd = 0.5) +
    geom_sf(data=bgd2 %>%
                filter(NAME_2 %in% c("Dhaka", "Chittagong", "Khulna",
                                     "Sylhet", "Rajshahi")),
            color=alpha("black",0.1),fill=NA) +  
    geom_sf_text(data=bgd2 %>%
                     filter(NAME_2 %in% c("Dhaka", "Chittagong", "Khulna",
                                          "Sylhet", "Rajshahi")),
                 aes(label=NAME_2),color=alpha("black",0.5),nudge_y=10000) +  
    scale_fill_distiller("Implied\ninfections",
                         trans="log",
                         palette="Spectral",
                         breaks=10^(0:5),
                         labels=c("1","10","100","1000","10000","100000")) + 
    coord_sf(datum = NA)  +
    ggspatial::annotation_scale(location = "bl", style = "bar",
                                bar_cols = c(alpha("black",.6), "white"),
                                line_width = .3) + 
    labs(x = "") +
    labs(y = "") +
    theme_void()

ggarrange(covs_rr_cor_plot,covs_infections_plot,ncol=2,
          labels = c("A", "B"))
ggsave(here("figures","fig2_raw.pdf"),height=6,width=10)
ggsave(here("figures","fig2_raw.png"),height=6,width=10)
```
